C0732.title: AI-Generated 'Qin Yueqing Buried Alive' Disinformation Incident
C0732.summary: In February 2025, a rumor circulated online claiming that 'Qin Yueqing was buried alive on February 23, 2025.' The content combined AI-generated images and text, fabricating multiple incident locations in an attempt to incite panic. After verification by Chengdu Internet Rumor Refutation, the incident was confirmed to be entirely fabricated; the circulated graphic images were from old news, and AI
